title: University of California and Berkeley campus requirements

requirements.title: Entry Level Writing

rules.text: Satisfied by exam (AP/IB English, SAT/ACT writing score, or the Analytical Writing Placement Exam)

requirements.notes: Most students satisfy ELW before arriving. Otherwise complete COLWRIT R1A with a C or better.

requirements.title: American History & Institutions

rules.text: Satisfied in high school (one year of US history and one semester of US government with grades of B or better) or by AP/IB exam

requirements.notes: Has a history half and an institutions half. One course may cover both; otherwise take one of each (e.g. HISTORY 7A/7B for history and POLSCI 1 for institutions).

requirements.title: American Cultures
requirements.notes: One course from the approved AC list (course numbers usually end in AC). Taken at Berkeley; it can also count toward breadth or major requirements.

requirements.title: 120 units
requirements.notes: At least 120 semester units. Some colleges cap P/NP, PE, and special studies units.
